text: <font=clinker:serif_soft><color=534337>    I talk to big mogul   Fatblade. He is grand and is leader of camp.
I tell him I write words. He says he too writes words and shows me his books. I cannot read what mogul Fatblade writes. I tell him I cannot  read his words and he throws  my   hat  in   the  fire!
So now, when fog  is thick, I steal   his pants!
Yes.   I have his mogul pants.
When on  journeys I keep books I find in mogul pants.   Drag over shoulder like sack.  I take books to secret cave.   Do not want mogul Fatblade to find and send as  offering
I will read   them so I  can write more  words.
